title: scikit-learn
line: Split your data, fit a model, score it and compare two fairly.

project.title: A handwritten digit reader
project.brief: Build a digit classifier on your own with load_digits. Hold out a test set, compare two pipelines with cross-validation and report test accuracy for the winner.
checks: A test set is held out with train_test_split before any fitting
Two pipelines are scored with 5-fold cross-validation
The chosen model scores at least 0.95 on the test set

lessons.title: Load data into X and y
lessons.goal: Teach how scikit-learn expects data. In Jupyter, load the wine dataset with load_wine(as_frame=True), look at it with pandas and split it into features X and a target y.
lessons.passes: X has shape (178, 13) and y holds 178 labels in three classes.

lessons.title: Train and test split
lessons.goal: Teach train_test_split in scikit-learn with test_size, random_state and stratify by holding out a quarter of the wine data for testing.
lessons.passes: X_train has 133 rows and X_test has 45 rows.

lessons.title: Fit and predict
lessons.goal: Teach the fit and predict pattern in scikit-learn by training a KNeighborsClassifier with 5 neighbours on the wine training set and predicting the test set.
lessons.passes: A fitted KNeighborsClassifier returns 45 predictions for the test set.

lessons.title: Score a classifier
lessons.goal: Teach scoring in scikit-learn with accuracy_score, confusion_matrix and classification_report by measuring the wine classifier on the test set.
lessons.passes: The notebook prints the test accuracy and a 3 by 3 confusion matrix.

lessons.title: Predict a number with regression
lessons.goal: Teach regression in scikit-learn with LinearRegression, mean_absolute_error and r2_score by predicting disease progression from the load_diabetes dataset.
lessons.passes: The notebook prints the test mean absolute error and R squared of a fitted model.

lessons.title: A pipeline with scaling
lessons.goal: Teach StandardScaler and make_pipeline in scikit-learn by putting scaling in front of the wine classifier and comparing test accuracy with and without it.
lessons.passes: A pipeline of StandardScaler then KNeighborsClassifier beats the unscaled model.

lessons.title: Cross-validation
lessons.goal: Teach cross_val_score in scikit-learn with cv=5 by scoring the wine pipeline on five folds and printing the mean and the standard deviation.
lessons.passes: Five fold scores print with their mean and standard deviation.

lessons.title: Tune a setting with a grid search
lessons.goal: Teach GridSearchCV in scikit-learn by trying n_neighbors from 1 to 15 in the wine pipeline and reading best_params_ and best_score_.
lessons.passes: A fitted GridSearchCV prints the best n_neighbors and its score.

lessons.title: Compare two models
lessons.goal: Teach comparing models fairly in scikit-learn by cross-validating the KNN pipeline against a LogisticRegression pipeline on the same folds and naming the better one.
lessons.passes: Mean cross-validation scores print for both models and the higher one is named.
